content: We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts (ppm) list: 88.85, 69.70, 68.60, 67.5, 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, 14.05. Need number of methyl (CH3) groups. Methyl carbons typically appear around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic methyls, maybe 14 ppm for terminal methyl, 18-30 for other methyls attached to heteroatoms etc. In list, low-field signals: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31. That's six signals in methyl region. However some could be methylene (CH2) also appear 20-40 ppm. Need to identify which are methyl. Typically CH2 around 20-40 as well. Need more info: maybe HSQC to see proton count. Could retrieve HSQC.
